item.title: Cabbage Beach Fence, Stefan Davis Tribute, Jet Ski Ramp
item.ns0:title: Cabbage Beach Fence, Stefan Davis Tribute, Jet Ski Ramp
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, tensions flare at Cabbage Beach as vendors and activists protest the unexpected re-erection of a controversial fence obstructing public beach access. Mourners gather for an emotional celebration of life honoring the creative legacy of prominent visual artist Stefan "Legend" Davis, while jet ski operators at Goodman's Bay demand urgent action over a neglected launch ramp. Plus, police on Grand Bahama probe the sudden death of a worker aboard a vessel in Bahamian waters, and dancehall icon Patra opens up about her mental health journey following a prestigious lifetime achievement award. Tune in for these top stories, alumni giving back in Grand Bahama, your weekend sports highlights, and the full weather forecast!
